news.title: WATCH: Trump says Fed Chair Warsh will 'do what he has to do' on possible rate hikes
news.summary: Trump suggested he's not necessarily opposed to Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh raising interest rates because of inflationary pressures, but he said that he thinks interest rates are "too high."
